tasks.final_text: My current favoriet food is the Catania salad at Pizzeria Limone. I believe I could eat the Catania every day and still crave it.  Chopped romaine is paired with grilled chicken, fresh orange slices, avocado, shaved Parmesan, and pistachios, and served alongside an orange vinaigrette that is simply delicious.  Simply writing about the Catania makes my mouth water!

Shopper's World is an open-air shopping center in Framingham, Massachusetts. The original facility (spelled Shoppers' World) is of historical significance as one of the first suburban shopping malls in the United States upon opening in 1951; though it had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.
